translations.web: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
translations.bsb: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
translations.kjv: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
translations.asv: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace. Psalm 30 A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House. A Psalm of David.
